brief:
The International Court of Justice's landmark finding that Myanmar committed genocide against the Rohingya could strengthen South Africa's case against Israel, according to Middle East Eye. The ICJ ruling establishes precedent in how the court applies genocide law, potentially influencing its assessment of South Africa's accusations that Israeli military operations in Gaza constitute genocide.

The Myanmar decision sets standards for proving genocidal intent and mass killing that may bear on South Africa's January case against Israel at the same court. Legal experts suggest the ruling's framework for evaluating state responsibility could reshape how the ICJ weighs evidence in the Gaza proceedings.

title: ICJ Rohingya ruling may aid South Africa's Israel case
